Application.Text1:
protocol_records:
record_id: A161-P001
record_type: reported_workflow_with_explicit_unreported_details
title: 
  value: 食管、胃与结直肠FFPE组织块的整块标记、ECi透明化与共聚焦三维采集
  source_refs: 
    [1]       source_id: F01
      locator: PDF p.4, Tissue-block processing
  check_status: verified_against_primary_source
purpose: 
  value: 恢复本文Table2与AppendixS1直接给出的处理条件及重叠标记时间；不套用切片成像设置。
  source_refs: 
    [1]       source_id: F01
      locator: PDF p.4, Tissue-block processing
  check_status: verified_against_primary_source
applicability: 
  value: 人食管/胃ESD、结肠EMR取得；10% buffered formalin固定并石蜡包埋；共14例，器官/病种适用范围保留原核心。
  source_refs: 
    [1]       source_id: F01
      locator: PDF p.2, Human specimens
  check_status: verified_against_primary_source
start_state: 
  value: 存档FFPE块，经内镜和切除组织图定位选块，组织学连续切片先取出，随后整块处理。
  source_refs: 
    [1]       source_id: F01
      locator: PDF pp.2,4, Tissue-block selection
  check_status: verified_against_primary_source
end_state: 
  value: ECi透明化块的CD34与核染三维图像
  source_refs: 
    [1]       source_id: F01
      locator: PDF p.4, Tissue-block processing
  check_status: verified_against_primary_source
materials: 
  [1]     value: 已固定并石蜡包埋的组织；10% buffered formalin固定史（具体时长/温度未报）
    source_refs: 
      [1]         source_id: F01
        locator: PDF p.2, Human specimens
    check_status: verified_against_primary_source
  [2]     value: Xylene、100/70/50% ethanol、PBS
    source_refs: 
      [1]         source_id: F01
        locator: PDF p.4, Table 2
    check_status: verified_against_primary_source
  [3]     value: Citrate pH6 S2369；PBS T900；TritonX100 T9284；BSA013-27054；CD34–Alexa647 QBend10/FAB7227R；SYTO16S7578；ECi112372
    source_refs: 
      [1]         source_id: F14
        locator: Appendix S1, Tissue-block processing for 3D reconstructed images; rendered pp.1–2
    check_status: verified_against_primary_source
  [4]     value: FV3000、UPLSAPO10x/UPLSAPO30x SIR；Imaris
    source_refs: 
      [1]         source_id: F14
        locator: Appendix S1, Imaging and analysis of 3D reconstructed images; rendered pp.2
    check_status: verified_against_primary_source
sections: 
  [1]     title: 选择与脱蜡
    steps: 
      [1]         step_id: A161-P001-S01
        display_order: 1
        action: 
          value: 选择同时具备白光、NBI、ME-NBI和切除组织体视图的材料；内镜医师和病理医师据图选择包含ROI的组织块。
          source_refs: 
            [1]               source_id: F01
              locator: PDF pp.2,4, Tissue-block selection
          check_status: verified_against_primary_source
        parameters: 
{}
        notes: 
          value: 该选择限定本文分析样本；不推断随机或连续入组。组织学切片支路见P002。
          source_refs: 
            [1]               source_id: F01
              locator: PDF pp.2,4, Tissue-block selection
          check_status: source_scope_limited
        legacy_P_or_row: null (as recorded in source)
      [2]         step_id: A161-P001-S02
        display_order: 2
        action: 
          value: 从石蜡块切出组织，刀片去除多余石蜡，并以paraffin block trimmer加热。
          source_refs: 
            [1]               source_id: F01
              locator: PDF p.4, Table 2
            [2]               source_id: F14
              locator: Appendix S1, Tissue-block processing for 3D reconstructed images; rendered pp.1–2
          check_status: verified_against_primary_source
        parameters: 
          cut_out: 
            value: RT, 5 min
            source_refs: 
              [1]                 source_id: F01
                locator: PDF p.4, Table 2
            check_status: verified_against_primary_source
          trimmer: 
            value: 62 °C, 5 min
            source_refs: 
              [1]                 source_id: F01
                locator: PDF p.4, Table 2
            check_status: verified_against_primary_source
        notes: 
          value: 刀片去除多余蜡来自Appendix S1；切出与trimmer先后按Table2，不补块尺寸或刀片型号。
          source_refs: 
            [1]               source_id: F01
              locator: PDF p.4, Table 2
          check_status: source_scope_limited
        legacy_P_or_row: null (as recorded in source)
      [3]         step_id: A161-P001-S03
        display_order: 3
        action: 
          value: 以二甲苯连续两轮脱蜡。
          source_refs: 
            [1]               source_id: F01
              locator: PDF p.4, Table 2
          check_status: verified_against_primary_source
        parameters: 
          first_xylene: 
            value: 60 °C, 90 min
            source_refs: 
              [1]                 source_id: F01
                locator: PDF p.4, Table 2
            check_status: verified_against_primary_source
          second_xylene: 
            value: 60 °C, 90 min
            source_refs: 
              [1]                 source_id: F01
                locator: PDF p.4, Table 2
            check_status: verified_against_primary_source
        notes: 
          value: 两个独立列出的xylene段保留；不因同试剂合并丢失重复。体积和换液方式未报告。
          source_refs: 
            [1]               source_id: F01
              locator: PDF p.4, Table 2
          check_status: source_scope_limited
        legacy_P_or_row: null (as recorded in source)
      [4]         step_id: A161-P001-S04
        display_order: 4
        action: 
          value: 依序乙醇复水，最后PBS过夜。
          source_refs: 
            [1]               source_id: F01
              locator: PDF p.4, Table 2
          check_status: verified_against_primary_source
        parameters: 
          ordered_series: 
            value: 
              [1] 100% ethanol, RT, 60 min
              [2] 70% ethanol, RT, 60 min
              [3] 50% ethanol, RT, 60 min
              [4] PBS, RT, overnight

        [1]           step_id: A161-P003-S03
          display_order: 3
          action: 
            value: 仅在实现一对一对应的病例，以side-view测血管距黏膜表面的深度及管径；ROI选择覆盖ME-NBI外观不同的血管。

            source_refs:

          legacy_P_or_row: null (as recorded in source)
